## Goals for the week
Below is an example checklist!

You can set some larger goals here, regardless of if you complete them or not!

- [ ] Set up the lab notebook
- [ ] Successfully make a first post
- [ ] Update a post!
- [ ] Make a post on how to render the notebook
- [ ] Add a guide to "push" updates to GitHub
